# Runtime-Profil: studio (Production auf einer Studio-Domain)
# Vorlage fuer lokale/operative Nutzung.
# Nicht-sensitive Struktur kann im Repo liegen; Secrets und lokale Overrides bleiben in studio.local.vars oder im Secret-Store.

SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=studio
QUANTUM_ENVIRONMENT=studio

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Instance-Routing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Legacy-/Migrations-Fallback fuer lokale oder uebergangsweise Profiles.
SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=studio.example.invalid
# Optional: separater Studio-Root; ohne Wert gilt weiterhin SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN.
# SVA_STUDIO_ROOT_HOST=admin.studio.example.invalid
# Bei Aktivierung gemeinsam überschreiben (einschließlich Keycloak-Redirects):
# SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://admin.studio.example.invalid
# SVA_PUBLIC_HOST=admin.studio.example.invalid
# SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI=https://admin.studio.example.invalid/auth/callback
# SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI=https://admin.studio.example.invalid/
# IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://admin.studio.example.invalid,https://example-instance.studio.example.invalid
SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS=example-instance
# Optionaler Operator-Override fuer Tenant-Smokes/Doctor; Remote-Scope kommt sonst aus der Registry.
# SVA_TENANT_SCOPE_INSTANCE_IDS=example-instance

# Kanonischer Auth-Host (Root-Domain, Fallback fuer Nicht-Instanz-Hosts)
SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://studio.example.invalid
SVA_DOCUMENTATION_BASE_URL=https://smart-village-solutions.github.io/sva-studio-user-documentation/
SVA_PUBLIC_HOST=studio.example.invalid
SVA_AUTH_ISSUER=https://keycloak.example.invalid/realms/sva-studio
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED=true
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ISSUER=https://keycloak.example.invalid/realms/sva-studio
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_AUDIENCE=sva-studio-mcp
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-mcp
SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio
SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI=https://studio.example.invalid/auth/callback
SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI=https://studio.example.invalid/
IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://studio.example.invalid,https://example-instance.studio.example.invalid
SVA_MAINSERVER_CLIENT_ID=studio-mainserver

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Auth / Keycloak
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL=https://keycloak.example.invalid
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM=sva-studio
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-iam-service
KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_BASE_URL=https://keycloak.example.invalid
KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_REALM=master
KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-provisioner
IAM_PII_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=k1

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Datenbank
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio
POSTGRES_USER=sva
APP_DB_USER=sva_app

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mainserver-Smoke (optional in der fruehen Studio-Testphase)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SVA_MAINSERVER_GRAPHQL_URL=https://example-instance.server.example.invalid/graphql
SVA_MAINSERVER_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL=https://example-instance.server.example.invalid/oauth/token
# SVA_MAINSERVER_CLIENT_SECRET liegt in studio.local.vars / Secret-Store
SVA_MAINSERVER_REQUIRED=false
SVA_MIGRATION_STATUS_REQUIRED=false
SVA_QUANTUM_NO_PRE_PULL=true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature-Flags
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
IAM_UI_ENABLED=true
IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=true
IAM_BULK_ENABLED=true
VITE_IAM_UI_ENABLED=true
VITE_IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=true
VITE_IAM_BULK_ENABLED=true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deployment (Quantum / Portainer)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SVA_STACK_NAME=studio
QUANTUM_ENDPOINT=sva
QUANTUM_ENDPOINT_ID=64

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Image
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SVA_REGISTRY=ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions
SVA_IMAGE_REPOSITORY=sva-studio

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring (deaktiviert – kein Monitoring-Stack in diesem Profil)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ENABLE_OTEL=false
# OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT wird nur benoetigt, wenn ENABLE_OTEL=true gesetzt ist.
SVA_ENABLE_SERVER_CONSOLE_LOGS=true
SVA_TRUST_FORWARDED_HEADERS=true
# Observability-Overlays fuer Operatoren koennen lokal in ~/.config/quantum/env liegen:
# SVA_GRAFANA_URL=https://logs.tpwd.de
# SVA_LOKI_URL=<loki-endpoint>
# SVA_GRAFANA_TOKEN=<read-only-token>
SVA_AUTH_DEBUG_HEADERS=true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sensible Variablen in studio.local.vars / Secret-Store / Deploy-Umgebung
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=
# SVA_AUTH_STATE_SECRET=
# KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=
# KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_SECRET=
# ENCRYPTION_KEY=
# IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON=
# SVA_MAINSERVER_CLIENT_SECRET=
# POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
# APP_DB_PASSWORD=
# REDIS_PASSWORD=

# Optional ableitbar fuer Remote-Profile:
# IAM_DATABASE_URL=postgres://...
# REDIS_URL=redis://...
# POSTGRES_PASSWORD
# APP_DB_PASSWORD
# REDIS_PASSWORD
# IAM_DATABASE_URL (optional, wird sonst aus APP_DB_* / POSTGRES_* abgeleitet)
# REDIS_URL (optional, wird sonst zur Laufzeit abgeleitet)
# SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
# SVA_AUTH_STATE_SECRET
# KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET
# ENCRYPTION_KEY
# IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON
=== staging ===
# GitHub-Environment "staging": Vorlage für das Secret APP_CONFIG.
# Nicht committen: Die aktive Kopie liegt in staging.local.vars.

SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=studio
SVA_STACK_NAME=studio-staging
SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://studio-staging.smart-village.app
SVA_DOCUMENTATION_BASE_URL=https://smart-village-solutions.github.io/sva-studio-user-documentation/
SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=studio-staging.smart-village.app
SVA_ALLOWED_INSTANCE_IDS=
SVA_AUTH_ISSUER=https://keycloak.smart-village.app/realms/studio-staging
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED=true
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_ISSUER=https://keycloak.smart-village.app/realms/studio-staging
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_AUDIENCE=sva-studio-mcp
SVA_STUDIO_MCP_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-mcp
SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio
SVA_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI=https://studio-staging.smart-village.app/auth/callback
SVA_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI=https://studio-staging.smart-village.app/
IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://studio-staging.smart-village.app
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL=https://keycloak.smart-village.app
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM=studio-staging
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-iam-service
KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_BASE_URL=https://keycloak.smart-village.app
KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_REALM=master
KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-provisioner
POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio
POSTGRES_USER=sva
APP_DB_USER=sva_app
IAM_PII_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=k1
IAM_UI_ENABLED=true
IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=true
IAM_BULK_ENABLED=true
VITE_IAM_UI_ENABLED=true
VITE_IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=true
VITE_IAM_BULK_ENABLED=true
IAM_DEBUG_PROFILE_ERRORS=false
SVA_ENABLE_SERVER_CONSOLE_LOGS=true
SVA_AUTH_DEBUG_HEADERS=false
SVA_KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=5000

# Secrets: ausschließlich in staging.local.vars und im GitHub-Secret APP_CONFIG.
SVA_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=__SET_STAGING_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET__
SVA_AUTH_STATE_SECRET=__SET_STAGING_AUTH_STATE_SECRET__
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=__SET_STAGING_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET__
KEYCLOAK_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_SECRET=__SET_STAGING_PROVISIONER_CLIENT_SECRET__
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=__SET_STAGING_POSTGRES_PASSWORD__
APP_DB_PASSWORD=__SET_STAGING_APP_DB_PASSWORD__
REDIS_PASSWORD=__SET_STAGING_REDIS_PASSWORD__
ENCRYPTION_KEY=__SET_STAGING_ENCRYPTION_KEY__
IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON=__SET_STAGING_PII_KEYRING_JSON__
=== public-waste ===
# Portainer-Stack-Name fuer die oeffentliche Abfallkalender-Webversion.
PUBLIC_WASTE_STACK_NAME=web-waste-calendar

# SemVer-Image-Tag des dedizierten Frontend-Images.
PUBLIC_WASTE_IMAGE_TAG=v0.0.0-dev

# Oeffentlicher Host und kanonische Basis-URL.
PUBLIC_WASTE_PUBLIC_HOST=prignitz.abfallkalender.pro
PUBLIC_WASTE_BASE_URL=https://prignitz.abfallkalender.pro

# Fachliche Runtime-Konfiguration.
PUBLIC_WASTE_INSTANCE_ID=bb-prignitz
PUBLIC_WASTE_SCHEMA_NAME=public
PUBLIC_WASTE_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres.example.invalid:5432/waste

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat config/runtime/studio.vars.example; echo "=== staging ==="; cat config/runtime/staging.vars.example; echo "=== public-waste ==="; cat config/runtime/public-waste.vars.example
